offering_description.value: Operates casino resorts and neighborhood casinos serving Las Vegas-area residents and visitors. Its properties offer gaming, hotel stays, dining and entertainment, and it also takes sports wagers through a Nevada mobile app.

primary_services.value: casino gaming and sports betting; hotel accommodation; dining and bars; live entertainment; meetings and events

customer_segment.value: B2C: Las Vegas-area residents, casino patrons and leisure travelers; B2B: Companies and event planners booking meetings, group stays and banquets

end_markets.value: casino gaming and sports betting; hospitality and tourism; dining; live entertainment; meetings and events

revenue_model.value: other: Net win from casino games and sports wagers; service fees: Room charges, restaurant and bar tabs, entertainment tickets and event packages

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Uses casino and resort properties, gaming equipment and staff to serve local patrons and visitors; service provider: Uses hospitality staff and facilities to serve overnight guests, diners and event organizers

geography_served.value: US regional: Las Vegas metropolitan area, Nevada, with mobile sports wagering available statewide

specialization.value: related lines: Casino resorts, neighborhood casinos, sportsbooks, hotels, restaurants and entertainment venues

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated casino resorts, neighborhood casinos and retail sportsbooks; online: Direct hotel booking websites and a Nevada mobile sports betting app; direct sales: Property sales teams handling group stays, meetings and banquets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Casino and sportsbook operations require Nevada gaming licenses and oversight by the Nevada Gaming Control Board and Nevada Gaming Commission.

notes: The current operating status of the California tribal casino project is uncertain.
